important_missing.question: Where some rejections are automated, will a person review every rejection that rests on a judgment of ability (as opposed to a documented, verifiable hard requirement)?
important_missing.why: Automated rejection is defensible only for checkable facts; judgments about people need a person (policy POL-AI-03).

important_missing.question: If data leaves India, to which countries?
important_missing.why: Transfers to countries restricted by government notification are not allowed.

important_missing.question: Is there an independent runtime check that can block individual decisions and withdraw the system's autonomy automatically if outcomes become unfair?
important_missing.why: Approval is a point-in-time judgment; runtime controls catch drift and misconfiguration.
